intro: Build your own AI team: create your teams and agents, pick a lead and describe the work to them; it gets split into tasks, handed out to agents, reviewed and written to long-term memory.

provider.title: What should the agents think with?
provider.hint: If Claude Code CLI is installed it works with your account; or enter an API key. You can change this later in Settings and pick a different provider per agent.

project.title: Your first project
project.hint: Project = a folder + the teams that work in it. CLI agents (Claude Code / Codex) only read and write files in the project folder (and extra folders you allow); pick a folder if you'll use them. Optional for Demo and API providers. Even if the project is deleted, the folder and its contents stay on disk.
project.appFolderError: This folder is the Agentbits app itself; it can't be selected so agents don't change the app's code.
project.noAgents: No agents yet; inside, the guide walks you through it step by step: team, agents, lead, permissions and the first job.
